instructions_to_main_agent: 1. BACKEND DECKSTRING DECODER & HEARTHSTONE METADATA: Use Python library `hearthstone` (pip install hearthstone in backend) or implement pure python Base64 Varint decoder. Cache `cards.collectible.json` from HearthstoneJSON locally or in memory so DBF IDs map instantly to Card ID, Name, Mana Cost, Rarity, Type, Class, and Card Text.

2. DECK IMPORT WORKFLOW: Allow pasting deck strings (e.g. AAECAfHhBAyV5ATDgweRqwfSrgeosQfQvwfqyQf2yQeb1Ae/3wey4wf85wcJodQEh/YEgf0GloIHl4IHvJQHupUHmsUH0MUHAAA=) with auto-detection of format (Standard/Wild), Hero Class, Mana Curve, Dust Cost, and 30 card list. Warn when duplicate deck string is imported with option to overwrite or save as alternate version.

3. CLASS THEMING & ICONS: Apply distinctive Blizzard class accent colors (Death Knight #C41E3A, Demon Hunter #15803D, Druid #FF7C0A, Hunter #AAD372, Mage #3FC7EB, Paladin #F48CBA, Priest #FFFFFF, Rogue #FFF468, Shaman #0070DE, Warlock #8788EE, Warrior #C69B6D) with glowing border highlights on deck cards and class filter pills.

4. INTERACTIVE CARD LIST & ART TILES: In deck details, display full 30-card list sorted by mana cost ascending. Show Hearthstone card tiles (`https://art.hearthstonejson.com/v1/tiles/{CARD_ID}.png`) with mana gem badge and quantity count (1 or 2, yellow star for legendary). Hovering or clicking on a card row displays the high-res 512px card render via Popover or HoverCard.
5. ONE-CLICK COPY TO CLIPBOARD: Prominent 'Copy Deck Code' button on both Deck Cards and Deck Details with animated copied checkmark feedback using sonner toast notification.
6. TAGS, NOTES, ARCHETYPES & FORMATS: Allow users to edit custom notes (mulligan guide, tech choices), add tags ('Aggro', 'Control', 'Combo', 'Tier 1', 'Legend Climb'), and switch format filter.

7. AUTH & SESSIONS: Standard HttpOnly cookie session via FastAPI with login, signup, and demo guest quick-start, seeding 4-5 sample top meta decks (e.g. Rainbow Death Knight, Insanity Warlock, Zarimi Priest, Reno Warrior, Pirate Demon Hunter) with full decoded card data.
8. RESPONSIVE DESIGN & TEST IDS: Ensure mobile layout collapses deck list smoothly. Add data-testid to every button, filter pill, search input, card tile row, and copy button.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous padding (p-6, p-8) around all panels with crisp 1px borders (border-[#282E3E]).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Gold/Amber (#F59E0B) highlights against dark obsidian (#0D0E12) and navy-charcoal (#151821) card surfaces.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography: Outfit for strong modern titles, Plus Jakarta Sans for clean readable UI text, JetBrains Mono for deckstrings and mana numbers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Mount <Toaster richColors position='top-right' /> once and trigger sonner toast on deck copy, save, edit, and delete actions.
